caveats: ⚑ skill1 trigger: kit says 'when performing a Full Charge attack'. The engine has no full-charge trigger kind; modeled as shotFired on a charge-weapon owner (every RL pull is a charge shot at scope lock). If she ever fires uncharged, this over-fires.

⚑ skill1 stat mapping: 'Explosion Radius ▲' is a geometry stat with no StatKey. Mapped to projectileExplosionPct (the RL-only Damage-Up stat) as the closest damage-bearing analogue — this is a MODELING CHOICE, not a kit-stated damage buff, and may over-credit. The faithful alternative is to leave it fully unmodeled (zero damage).

⚑ skill2 trigger: 'Activates when an attack hits more than 4 enemy unit(s)' is a MULTI-TARGET count gate. The scope-lock boss is a SINGLE partless enemy, so the real in-game condition is NEVER satisfied at scope lock — the whole skill2 block is arguably INERT. Modeled live on shotFired as the optimistic reading; the pessimistic reading (drop both skill2 blocks) is equally defensible and must be settled by a recording before either number is trusted.

⚑ skill2 DEF ▼ 3.52%: a boss DEF debuff. The schema has no defDown StatKey (defPct is self-DEF and inert). Left in `unmodeled` rather than folded into damageTakenPct — those are different buckets and the fold would be a fudge. Recipe: model boss DEF reduction when/if the engine gains the channel.
⚑ burst noFb: burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens (verified project fact), so noFb:true on the 192% is convention, not a per-kit measurement.
⚑ cadence (ammo 6 / reloadFrames 141 / chargeFrames 90) is datamine-sourced and unreliable; every per-shot rider's rate rides on it.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Belorta is an RL/Electric/Attacker/Burst II. Three kit lines carry damage-relevant content and each has a structural problem the prose does not resolve: (1) S1's Explosion Radius has no damage StatKey — mapped to projectileExplosionPct as the nearest RL analogue; (2) S2's activation clause requires hitting >4 enemies, a condition the single partless scope-lock boss cannot satisfy, so its DEF▼ and 14.96% rider may be entirely inert in this sim's fight; (3) S2's DEF▼ has no engine channel and is recorded verbatim in `unmodeled`. The burst is clean: 192% of final ATK instant enemy damage (FB-exempt, burst-cast timing) plus a 2.82%/10s team Charge Speed buff. Full-kit audit: no line silently dropped.
